events.text: Hi! Tell me about your business.

I run Luna Hair Studio in Austin. Women's haircuts are $45, men's haircuts are $30, and highlights start at $90. We're open Tuesday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm, closed Sundays and Mondays. Customers book by messaging us here.
What would you like your bot to help with?
Answer questions about our prices and hours, and collect the customer's name and preferred appointment time.
